sections.title: Predictive Analytics Suite
sections.subtitle: Reusable predictive models, adapted and validated for your customer, demand and risk decisions.

backgroundImage.alt: Abstract data network illustrating predictive analytics

sections.heading: Put predictive insight to work
sections.body:
The Predictive Analytics Suite provides reusable model starting points for customer, demand and risk decisions, rather than a standalone licensed product. Data preparation, calibration, validation and integration remain specific to your organisation; assessment establishes which reusable assets fit the decision.

[Assess your use case](#get-in-touch). Share the decision, available data and intended users, not confidential datasets.

sections.heading: Models for customer, demand and risk decisions
sections.description: Reuse the model family; tailor features, thresholds, evaluation and the route into a decision.

items.title: Churn and segmentation
items.description: Adapt the suite’s customer model starting points to your customer history and engagement context.
items.bullets:
Inputs – customer behaviour and retention history
Outputs – churn probability and distinct customer segments
Decision – prioritise retention and engagement

items.title: Demand forecasting
items.description: Adapt demand models to your planning horizon, demand drivers and operating constraints.
items.bullets:
Inputs – historical demand and relevant drivers
Output – forecast for an agreed horizon
Decision – plan stock, capacity or resources

items.title: Fraud and anomaly detection
items.description: Adapt detection models to the activity in scope and the team’s investigation rules.
items.bullets:
Inputs – transactions, activity and reviewed outcomes
Output – prioritised anomalies for investigation
Decision – route cases to human review

items.title: Loan default prediction
items.description: Adapt risk models to the lending population and the credit decision they will support.
items.bullets:
Inputs – lending history and repayment outcomes
Output – default-risk score with limitations
Decision – support credit and portfolio review

sections.note: Select model versions, supported data formats and evaluation criteria for the use case. A reusable starting point is not a validated model for your organisation.

sections.heading: From a decision question to a usable model
sections.description: An engagement pattern with agreed outputs at each gate. Reuse avoids designing every model starting point from scratch; validation is still required.

items.title: Decision brief
items.description: Agree the decision, owner and action a prediction should support.
items.bullets:
Reuse – relevant model family
Accept – scope and evaluation criteria

items.title: Readiness findings
items.description: Review history, labels, access and data quality before model adaptation.
items.bullets:
Tailor – features and data preparation
Accept – data gaps and remediation plan

items.title: Validated model
items.description: Calibrate and test against relevant historical outcomes, with limitations recorded.
items.bullets:
Tailor – thresholds and decision context
Accept – evaluation and review evidence

items.title: Integrated pilot
items.description: Connect outputs to a controlled decision workflow and define monitoring ownership.
items.bullets:
Tailor – integration and human review
Accept – pilot and monitoring plan

sections.note: Customer activity and retention history → a churn probability and segment → a retention team reviews the context → an appropriate action is recorded. This is an engagement example, not a client case study or measured result.

sections.heading: Is your data ready for prediction?
sections.description: First value is an accepted model output in a defined pilot. Timing depends on data readiness, validation requirements and integration scope, not the accelerator name.

items.title: Data and access
items.description: Discovery or data engineering comes first when usable history, labels or access are missing.
items.bullets:
Agree – history, labels and permitted use
Check – quality, representativeness and access
Name – data owner

items.title: Decision controls
items.description: Predictions inform a decision; they do not remove the need for accountable review.
items.bullets:
Name – business decision owner
Agree – human review and escalation
Review – explainability and fairness where relevant

items.title: Deployment and support
items.description: Choose the pilot boundary before estimating delivery or committing to production use.
items.bullets:
Agree – hosting, integration and permissions
Define – monitoring and change thresholds
Name – deployment and support owners

sections.note: Accelerator adoption is scoped separately from software licensing. Agree the engagement model, reuse and handover rights, licence dependencies and ongoing support before delivery.

sections.heading: Connect prediction to delivery
sections.description: Potential contexts include telecom retention, retail demand planning and BFSI fraud or credit review.

items.title: Power BI + AI/ML
items.description: Present model outputs in forecast and risk-review views that reporting users can interpret.

items.title: Intelligent Workflow Automation
items.description: Route scores into controlled workflows with human approvals and exception handling.
